audit_scope.evidence_rule: Only durable text governance, manifest, result, and completion artifacts were used. Absence of an access artifact is not by itself proof; the positive no-access bindings recorded below are required for the Mode1 lockbox conclusion.

access_levels.PARTITION_DECODED: A container library decoded a complete source partition before row selection. Unselected rows may remain administratively unscored, but the partition cannot be described as byte-level untouched.
access_levels.SELECTED_OR_SCORED: Numeric rows were selected, transformed, fitted, calibrated, scored, diagnosed, or used to choose a method. They are permanently exploratory or historical.
access_levels.METADATA_ONLY: Only source identity, group existence, status, shape, dtype, or seed metadata were inspected; no processdata or idv_init array value was decoded.
access_levels.NEVER_NUMERIC_ACCESSED: Durable phase records explicitly bind zero authorized opens and zero numeric reads for the named HDF5 branch.

v6_lockbox_budget.rule_before_mode1_magnitude25: The unique model, transforms, weights, score map, scan, threshold-rank rule, gates, implementation files, source identity, environment, and CPU/CUDA policy must be frozen and hash-bound.
v6_lockbox_budget.calibration_no_go_rule: Any invalid or failed magnitude25 calibration is terminal and leaves magnitude75 sealed.
v6_lockbox_budget.confirmation_rule: Any magnitude75 open, including a partial read or infrastructure failure after access intent, permanently consumes the lockbox and forbids same-data rescue or retuning.
v6_lockbox_budget.new_method_after_lockbox_rule: A successor method requires a genuinely new external lockbox; it may not reuse Mode1 magnitude25 or magnitude75 as fresh confirmation data.

required_reporting_statements: PCF-CycleRank-Scan v6 ended in a terminal protocol-handshake infrastructure abort before HDF5 decode or training; it produced no scientific GO or NO_GO result and cannot be rerun under the same candidate or a rescue iteration ID.
All Mode2 development metrics are adaptive exploratory feasibility evidence after multiple method versions, not an unbiased generalization estimate.
Mode1 magnitude75 is a cell-level prospective target-domain confirmation, not a wholly unseen dataset-level external or zero-shot validation.

A rank96 threshold from 100 exchangeable target-domain healthy run maxima with strict greater-than has marginal exceedance at most 5/101; this is not a conditional PAC or automatic cross-mode guarantee.
The final healthy alarm count must receive an exact one-sided 95 percent Clopper-Pearson upper bound; at most 4/100 supports below 0.10 and at most 1/100 supports below 0.05.
Per-fault detection intervals use 100 independent simulator runs per fault under the stated seed assumption; the pooled 300 fault outcomes do not receive a Binomial(300) interval.
All predecessor NO_GO and failed confirmation results, together with the terminal v6 handshake abort, must be disclosed with any successor result.
